world.title: HIV patients with cancer must travel farther than others to access clinical trials
world.description: For people living with HIV, the road to a promising cancer treatment can be longer than it should be. According to a new study from researchers at the University of Notre Dame, HIV-positive cancer patients face significantly longer travel times than cancer patients without HIV to receive chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T) therapy, an experimental treatment that may help target cancer cells while resisting HIV infection.
